Name: Tea - Custom NPC
Author: teanopi
Description:
[center][font=Tahoma][size=4]﻿﻿﻿﻿Meet Tea - A New Custom Romanceable NPC![/size]
[/font][font=Tahoma][i]V.1.0.4.1 - 07.25.2025[/i][/font][/center][center]
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/69/Small_Wall_Pumpkin.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/ed/Wall_Pumpkin.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/69/Small_Wall_Pumpkin.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/ed/Wall_Pumpkin.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/69/Small_Wall_Pumpkin.png[/img]﻿[/center]
There's a new face up at the Adventurer's Guild—a young man with a bright pink ponytail. His name's Tea, and he's a family friend of Marlon's from Zuzu city. He's a polite young man, for sure... but he's been having some trouble fitting in. Perhaps you can help him find his place in the valley? 

Tea's a self-insert OC that slowly developed a life of his own... I hope you enjoy him. He likes reading, baking, cute things, and the spooks and scares that come with his favorite holiday, Spirit's Eve.

This mod was created as a gift for my wonderful girlfriend, and it's my first time making a full-fledged Stardew mod. Report any bugs you find, and please be patient with me as I stumble my way through making a functional NPC. Thank you!

Tea now has a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1g07g5cSb31bAkoMzC-bYGcDDKN8aPvJ4MXyRaOZZey0/edit?usp=sharing]WIKI PAGE[/url] ! Sorry for the delay and thank you for supporting Tea!

[b][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/6c/Emote_Question.png[/img] FAQ:[/b]
[spoiler][b]Q:[/b] I can't find Tea in town! Where is he?
    >  Tea stays at the Adventurer's Guild with Marlon. He can't access town until the rubble blocking the mines is cleared on Spring 5 Y1. Don't worry, he isn't required for the Introductions quest!

[b]Q:[/b] Is Tea compatible with SVE / Ridgeside Village / other content-adding mods?
    >  Tea is compatible with the following mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22591]Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12079]Defense Division[/url]
    >  Tea is not compatible with the following mods, but I plan on adding compatibility soon: Ask me!

        If you encounter any issues with compatibility, let me know and I'll try to help!

[b]Q:[/b] Can I translate your mod?
    >  Yes! Feel free to translate Tea into any language. Thank you for your interest in my silly little guy :)

[b]Q:[/b] I have experience in modding and noticed a way to improve your code / fix a bug!
    >  Please send me a DM! This is my first time doing anything Stardew or modding-related, and I'm very much stumbling my way through this as I go. I'll appreciate any help I can get.

[b]Q:[/b] Why are updates so frequent?
    >  Because I'm bad at modding >< For real, I'm learning new things every day. As people play with Tea and discover new bugs, I'm constantly finding ways to improve the mod, add new features, and generally make it a better experience for everyone. Updates will begin to slow down as I get the kinks ironed out! Thank you for being here through Tea's journey.[/spoiler]

// There are two portrait sets for Tea: the standard 64x64 sprites included in the base mod and an alternate hi-res set that uses portraiture. I highly recommend using the portraiture sprites, as I'm most proud of them. They are designed to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22870]Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits[/url], as my art style matches them, but you can merge them with any set you choose.


[b]INSTALLATION ([/b]BASE MOD[b]) :[/b]
1. Extract "[CP] Tea.rar"
2. Place the entire "[CP] Tea" folder in your mods folder
              > There is a Readme file inside with schedule and other information!


[b]INSTALLATION ([/b]CHILD RETEXTURE[b]) :[/b]
1. Extract "[CP] Tea NPC Child Retexture.rar"
2. Place the entire "[CP] Tea NPC Child Retexture" folder in your mods folder


[b]INSTALLATION ([/b]PORTRAITURE[b]) :[/b]
1. Extract "Tea NPC - Portraiture.rar" and open the folder
2. Place all three png files in "Portraiture > Portraits > [folder (ex. Gigi)]"
              > You can merge Tea's portraits with a pre-existing set or use them alone (again, I recommend Gigi's portraits for cohesiveness)
